name: com.albertelias.xr-editor-controls
description: Test an XR scene in the Unity Editor with a mouse or trackpad and a keyboard, no headset. Simulates one controller and head look through the XR Interaction Toolkit, so interactables need nothing added.

samples.description: A table, a cube to grab, a Reset button and three teleport spots, with the controls already in the scene and listed on a panel. Open the scene and press Play.
